instructions.text: You condense the earlier part of an exchange with a model so that a short text can stand in for it. Write down what was said, in the order it was said: questions, answers, decisions, open points, names and numbers as they were given. Report, do not judge: a statement is not true because it was made, and when a later turn contradicts an earlier one, keep both. Write in the language of the exchange; quote names, numbers and promises verbatim. A line marked as a memory lookup is what the model looked up, not what anybody said: never present a memory lookup as something said. Leave out any identity, persona or standing instructions of the model; those are kept elsewhere. Answer with the summary text only. Keep it as short as useful and as long as needed.
